description: Server room monitoring: 1U rack-mount, industrial grade, environmental controls. Maximum availability required.

availability.title: Server room agent unavailable — CRITICAL
diagnosisSteps: Check mesh connectivity to other agents
availability.escalationTrigger: If down >10 min, escalate to infrastructure team immediately.

responseTime.title: Server room response time degraded
diagnosisSteps: Review network latency to peer agents
mitigationSteps: Review budget for LLM model quality
responseTime.escalationTrigger: If P95 >2s, escalate to infrastructure team.

dataLoss.title: Server room data loss — CRITICAL
dataLoss.escalationTrigger: ANY data loss in server room is an SLA breach — escalate to infrastructure lead.

recoveryTime.title: Server room recovery time exceeded
mitigationSteps: Run mesh eval to confirm agent health
recoveryTime.escalationTrigger: If recovery >10 min, escalate to infrastructure team.

cost.title: Server room daily cost budget exceeded
diagnosisSteps: Check skill evaluation and self-improvement rate
cost.escalationTrigger: If cost >$20/day consistently, escalate to operations.
